decision: docs/05 §9 baselines. Published by the human owner through nexloop.context.strategy.publish:1 (NX-023); both share goals and mandatory constraints and differ only in research-relevant evidence selection. v2 (S82, owner 2026-11-01 as L6 recommended; K1 tests/test_model_surface.py measured framing): framing_reserve 1500 -> 3900 in both strategies, version 2 of each. The reserve is the largest K1 framing of the Run kinds a strategy serves plus 15%: message reply 3409 -> 3900, plan reevaluation 2822 -> 3250, fallback reply 1997 -> 2300, outreach 3375 -> 3900; both strategies may serve every Run kind (the relay's --context-strategy, the reply guarantee's fallback strategy), so each takes the largest, 3900. input_token_budget and output_reserve unchanged: the pack budget (budget_report.available = input_token_budget - framing_reserve) becomes 12100 tokens (was 14500). v1 stays published; v2 is the next version of each strategy (0088: dense, immutable).
